---
title: "Patch supplementary figures — stable MCI effect size scatter"
---

## Overview

Apply publication theming to the two stable-MCI effect-size scatter plots and save each as a high-resolution PNG for the supplementary figures.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
```

The correlation labels in these plots are already authored at `size = 6 / .pt` (6 pt, the journal
minimum), so `rescale_layer_params()` is deliberately not applied here — it would shrink them below
legibility. `theme_main_fig()` supplies the publication typography instead, and its textbox strip
elements render the HTML site counts in the extended-DMP facet labels.

## Load RDS plots

```{r}
#| label: load-rds

scatter_DMP <- read_rds(here("stable_mci_focused/output/scatter_DMP.rds"))
scatter_extended <- read_rds(here("stable_mci_focused/output/scatter_extended.rds"))
```

## Effect size comparison between stable_mci and other transitions for DMPs

```{r}
#| label: fig-sup-stable-mci-DMP
fs::dir_create(here("stable_mci_focused/patch_figures/output"))

fig_sup_stable_mci_DMP <- scatter_DMP +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(here("stable_mci_focused/patch_figures/output/fig_sup_stable_mci_DMP.png"),
       fig_sup_stable_mci_DMP,
       width = 6.5, height = 6.0, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Effect size association between stable_mci and prevalent dementia for extended DMPs

```{r}
#| label: fig-sup-stable-mci-extended-prev

fig_sup_stable_mci_extended_prev <- scatter_extended$prev +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(here("stable_mci_focused/patch_figures/output/fig_sup_stable_mci_extended_prev.png"),
       fig_sup_stable_mci_extended_prev,
       width = 6.5, height = 3.4, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Effect size association between stable_mci and the other transitions for extended DMPs

Stack the three remaining comparisons, keeping a single legend on the top panel.

```{r}
#| label: fig-sup-stable-mci-extended-transitions

fig_sup_stable_mci_extended_transitions <-
  (scatter_extended$normal2incid + theme_main_fig() + theme(legend.position = "top")) +
  (scatter_extended$mci2incid + theme_main_fig() + theme(legend.position = "none")) +
  (scatter_extended$normal2mci + theme_main_fig() + theme(legend.position = "none")) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, guides = "keep", axes = "keep", axis_titles = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")

ggsave(here("stable_mci_focused/patch_figures/output/fig_sup_stable_mci_extended_transitions.png"),
       fig_sup_stable_mci_extended_transitions,
       width = 6.5, height = 8.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Verify output

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  here("stable_mci_focused/patch_figures/output"),
  glob = "*sup*"
)
fs::file_info(output_files) |>
  select(path, size, modification_time) |>
  mutate(path = basename(path))
```
